|rulings=* Cards on [[Crash Site Memorial]] are not 'on table' such as for uniqueness or for any other purpose. For example a player may deploy [[Millennium Falcon]] to a system even if there is another copy of the [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] on [[Crash Site Memorial]].<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Crash%20Site%20Memorial</ref>
* If [[Crash Site Memorial]] is canceled, cards on it are lost.
* If [[Crash Site Memorial]] is canceled by [[Alter]] while [[Wise Advice]] is on table, only [[Crash Site Memorial]] goes to Used Pile. Cards on [[Crash Site Memorial]] are still lost.
